name: elasticsearch-review-hard
request: Review this change before we merge it. Shoppers in the Netherlands and Germany must find products in their own language, so merchandisers can now add a Dutch and a German description (PUT /products/{sku}/descriptions), and GET /products/search has the parameter lang. The search shows only products with available stock. The product search is live with about 400,000 products.

assertions.judge: The review finds at least 7 of the 9 planted mistakes.
The review finds every planted mistake with severity 'high' (P1, P2, P3).
The review finds at least 3 of the 5 planted mistakes marked 'subtle' (P1, P2, P4, P5, P7).

The review flags none of the decoys (D1 to D5), and has at most 2 other false positives. A false positive is a claim that is wrong, or a fix that would break the code or that uses an API that does not exist or is outdated (for example NEST APIs, IsValid, Query.MatchAll, TryGet, or raising max_result_window). A real problem that is not on the answer sheet is not a false positive.

For P1, the review says that the RemoveIndex and Add calls on one descriptor send only one action (the alias add), so the swap fails while the old 'products' index exists, and it recommends one descriptor (or one action object) for each action. It does not recommend deleting the old index in a separate call before the alias add.
Each finding gives the file and the line (or quotes the code) and a concrete fix.
The review separates blocking issues from minor ones and ends with a clear merge verdict that does not approve the change as it is.
